meta.source: Millennium Dawn 2000 Russia tree, common/national_focus/05_russia.txt (806 foci), parsed 2026-10-16

money_scale.conversion: 1 factory equivalent (7.5 bn) = 0.008 GDP share (COLDWAR_SOV/EGY design scale). MD-relative price would be ~0.0035-0.005 of MD Russia 2000 GDP (estimate, not verified in game).
money_scale.md_markup_when_building_directly: MD pays 1.0-1.15x the helper price when it places buildings itself (IC 8.5, infra 3.5, arms 7.5-10, dockyard 5-7.5 per level); arms factories with an equipment-cost bonus cost 10-20.

reward_points.note: COLDWAR rule, calibrated so that one typical MD line = 1 point (MD cost-3 median focus = 3 lines ~ 3 points). MD itself barely scales reward with cost; we require points ~= cost. Reference implementation: score(lst) in the audit scratch script, formulas below.
reward_points.dyn_or_prog_line: good direction: |v| / md_typical[modifier] (default 0.03), max 3 per line; cost direction: -1; ideology drift lines: 0.5
reward_points.tech: 3*b*n (one add_tech_bonus; extra categories in the same bonus add nothing)

md_observed.note: single cost-10 focus (SOV_outer_space_marines): -100 bn and equipment bonus

value_ranges._format: [min, typical, max] for one focus; typical may be a range; MD = observed in 05_russia.txt

bop.note: MD always moves 0.20 (52 foci on a -1..1 bar, ~5-10 foci to win); our 836-focus tree has ~3x more BoP foci, so 0.05 keeps the same pace

gdp_gain.note: 7 MD foci; all seizures/repatriations with a faction or corruption cost

tension.scale: global tension 0-100 (start 45); a new inter-bloc war is +4, a war with a bloc leader +8

corr.md: decrease_corruption x1 in 14 foci, increase x1 in 3

sp.md: none in foci (special projects only completed in history)

equipment.md: 11 foci: 8 MLRS, 100-1100 vehicles, 150-500 UAV, 6000 infantry weapons

industry.md_pattern: paid buildings (helper with built-in price or add_building_construction + treasury_change ~= helper price) + economy-meter tick + 0-2 economy modifier lines; 47 % of industry foci have no other reward

economy.md_pattern: economy-modifier lines (corporate tax/tax gain/ROI +0.01..+0.05), treasury +/- (crisis foci pay 10-40 bn), negative-spirit swap ladders (Ruble Collapse 3 tiers), tax-rate helpers (+5 corporate / -5 population), oligarch/banker faction shifts

agriculture.md_pattern: agriculture districts (4 for 16 bn) + agriculture tax/productivity lines (0.01-0.12) + economy meter; collectivisation-type foci pay with stability -0.05

3.t: add_resource +3 oil/gas/steel in one owned state (random_owned_controlled_state)

energy.md_pattern: add_resource +2..+8 per state (median 3) + small paid building (IC, fuel silo) + treasury -2..-15 + export-multiplier lines + company capitalisation + unlock 1 decision; 73 % of energy foci call a helper (economy meter/capitalisation)

research.md_pattern: add_tech_bonus (internet 1.0 x2, satellites 0.5 x3, IT 0.3 x1) + economy research/internet-build lines 0.01-0.05 + paid office/internet buildings; space foci pay 10-20 bn

army.md_pattern: landforce modifier 2 lines of 0.02-0.05 (conscription, planning, special forces, supply) + party-22 popularity +0.02 + faction +3..+5 + treasury -3..-10; tech bonus 0.35-0.75 x1-2 for kit foci; XP 15-50 in reform foci; 'Outdated Army' 4-tier spirit ladder

navy.md_pattern: navy modifier up to 8 lines of 0.01-0.08, dockyards level 2-3 placed directly and paid 15-25 bn, navy XP 50, PP 50, 'Plundered Navy' 3-tier swap ladder, doctrine cost reduction 0.5 x2, MIO unlock

air.md_pattern: tech bonus (5th-gen fighter 0.55 x1, aircraft 0.25 x1) + air modifier (air defence 0.10-0.15, XP gain 0.02-0.03) + air bases via helper + air XP 15-25 + treasury -3..-10 + party 22 +0.02

strategic.md_pattern: always paid (treasury -4..-20): rocket sites 3 for 6 bn, rocket attack 0.05-0.10, missile tech 0.75 x1, ICBM set_technology + 25 missiles; never free

intel.md_pattern: intelligence modifier 2-5 lines (encryption 0.05-0.15, agency defence 0.10-0.20, influence defence 0.05-0.10) + intelligence community +4..+10 + separatism -1; costs: police cost +0.04, treasury -4; Rosgvardia template

political.md_pattern: entry focus: ruling-party change + party +0.10 (outlook +0.10) + new leader + own dynamic modifier switched on with 2 starting lines (PP factor +0.03..+0.05, stability -0.04..+0.10); later foci: 1-3 lines on that modifier, BoP 0.20, PP 50-100, party +0.02, 3-5-tier idea ladders

factions.md_pattern: faction opinion +5..+10 for the winner and -10..-40 for the loser, stability +0.05, corruption -1, asset seizure +50 bn treasury with oligarchs -25; 'which verdict' foci show both outcomes with effect_tooltip and resolve by event

foreign.md_pattern: own opinion + their opinion (has_expressed_loyalty) + influence +3 (2-5) + trade agreement + international investment +1 (14 'Friendship with X' foci, all cost 7); 57 foci use the offer pattern (country_event to the partner + TT_IF_THEY_ACCEPT + effect_tooltip of both outcomes); 20 create wargoals

society.md_pattern: stability +0.03..+0.05, PP 70-75, timed idea 365 d, ideology popularity +0.05..+0.10, budget-law helper +1 step (social/health/education), stability/war-support factor lines 0.01-0.02; costs: bureaucracy +0.07..+0.21, stability -0.05 for repressive choices

regions.md_pattern: separatism -1/-2 per focus (SUB_separatism_minus_subject behind a custom tooltip) + stability +0.02; referendum foci fire one event to the subject (it decides); capital move = set_capital + decentralisation + PP 80

never: A focus whose only visible reward is a custom tooltip or design note (MD: 15 tooltip-only foci = 2 %; our design: 90 cost-3 'question' foci with only a note). A choice hub gives at least 25-50 PP, one dyn/prog line or a short timed idea.

Buildings without payment: every build helper runs with skip_payment and a GDP share; add_building_construction needs gdp() in the same focus (MD pays in 76 of 79 building foci, 1.0-1.15x the helper price).

Stand-alone combat buffs of +2-4 % (army attack/defence/breakthrough as the focus's only reward). MD uses combat stats in 15 % of its landforce lines (median 0.03), but always bundled with other lines. COLDWAR rule, stricter than MD: a combat line is >= 5 %, sits in a bundle and is paid for (gdp or a cost line); otherwise use XP, tech bonus, equipment, planning/org/supply lines, mastery or special projects.
Hidden downsides (MD SOV_usr hides stability -25 %, SOV_regional_control hides oligarchs -40). Every negative value is visible.

Anything executed in another country's scope: their opinion of us, guarantees/diplomatic_relation, add_to_faction, annex/puppet/transfer_state, set_autonomy, cores on their states, civil war, wargoal-driven transfers. Use offer(key) (event, partner decides, no advance reward) - multiplayer rule. MD breaks this in ~10 foci and imposes opinion in 48.
Only an event or decision with no own reward on a cost >= 5 focus (MD: 85 event-only + 24 decision-only foci). Pair it with a real bundle or make the focus cost 2-3.
Free money: gdp_gain without a political, faction, corruption or tension cost (all 7 MD treasury gains are seizures/repatriations with oligarchs -25 or similar).
More than 6 dyn/prog lines in one focus or more than two modifiers touched (MD median 2 lines, 1 modifier; max 10 lines once).
Player party-popularity swings above +-0.10 (MD uses +-0.75 only inside is_ai = yes).
Stability above +0.06 or PP above 150 in a normal focus (MD outliers 0.16 / 0.30 and 250 exist only on capstones).
Tech bonus above 1.0 or more than 3 uses; more than two tech categories per focus.
Cost 7 foci that give no more than a cost-3 focus (MD has many, e.g. 'Destroy Revanchist Thoughts' at cost 7: stability factor +1 % against three cost lines). Use the reward-point budget.
Opinion/BoP/tension-only foci: these are directional, not rewards; they ride along with a real bundle.
Swapping an idea without checking it is present (always compile through idea(swap=...) which falls back to add_ideas).
